arxiv-2005-06086.description: Abstract . We present algorithms and their implementation to compute limit cycles and their isochrons for state-dependent delay equations (SDDE’s) which are perturbed from a planar differential equation with a limit cycle. Note that the space of solutions of an SDDE is infinite dimensional.

arxiv-2202-11991.title: Spectral form factor in the Hadamard-Gutzwiller model: orbit pairs contributing in the third order
arxiv-2202-11991.creator: Huynh M. Hien
arxiv-2202-11991.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Huynh M. Hien. In this paper we consider orbit pairs contributing in the third order of the spectral form factor in the Hadamard-Gutzwiller model. We prove that periodic orbits including two 2-encounters in certain structures have partner orbits.

arxiv-2204-12062.title: Scheduling Virtual Conferences Fairly: Achieving Equitable Participant and Speaker Satisfaction Conference: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2022; April 25–29, 2022; Virtual Event, Lyon, France Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2022 (WWW ’22), April 25–29, 2022, Virtual Event, Lyon, France
arxiv-2204-12062.creator: Gourab K. Patro, Prithwish Jana, Abhijnan Chakraborty, Krishna P. Gummadi, Niloy Ganguly
arxiv-2204-12062.description: Abstract . Recently, almost all conferences have moved to virtual mode due to the pandemic-induced restrictions on travel and social gathering. Contrary to in-person conferences, virtual conferences face the challenge of efficiently scheduling talks, accounting for the availability of participants from different timezones and their interests in attending different talks.

arxiv-2303-00496.title: Universal diagonal estimates for minimizers of the Levy-Lieb functional
arxiv-2303-00496.creator: S. Di Marino, A. Gerolin, L. Nenna
arxiv-2303-00496.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by S. Di Marino, A. Gerolin, L. Nenna. Given a wave-function minimizing the Levy-Lieb functional, the intent of this short note is to give an estimate of the probability of the particles being in positions ( x 1 , … , x N ) (x_{1},\ldots,x_{N}) in the δ \delta -close regime D δ = ∪ i ≠ j { | x i − x j | ≤ δ } D_{\delta}=\cup_{i\neq j}\{|x_{i}-x_{j}|\leq\delta\} .

arxiv-2303-09024.title: DeeBBAA: A benchmark Dee p B lack B ox A dversarial A ttack against Cyber-Physical Power Systems
arxiv-2303-09024.creator: Arnab Bhattacharjee, Tapan K. Saha, Ashu Verma, Sukumar Mishra
arxiv-2303-09024.description: Abstract An increased energy demand, and environmental pressure to accommodate higher levels of renewable energy and flexible loads like electric vehicles have led to numerous smart transformations in the modern power systems. These transformations make the cyber-physical power system highly susceptible to cyber-adversaries targeting its numerous operations.

arxiv-2309-05970.title: Coloured corner processes from asymptotics of LLT polynomials
arxiv-2309-05970.creator: Amol Aggarwal, Alexei Borodin and Michael Wheeler
arxiv-2309-05970.description: Abstract . We consider probability measures arising from the Cauchy summation identity for the LLT (Lascoux–Leclerc–Thibon) symmetric polynomials of rank n ⩾ 1 n\geqslant 1 . We study the asymptotic behaviour of these measures as one of the two sets of polynomials in the Cauchy identity stays fixed, while the other one grows to infinity.

arxiv-2403-04958.title: Efficiency of Non-Thermal Pulsed Emission from Eight MeV Pulsars
arxiv-2403-04958.creator: J. Takata, H.-H. Wang, L.C.-C., Lin, S. Kisaka
arxiv-2403-04958.description: Abstract We report on the properties of pulsed X-ray emission from eight MeV pulsars using XMM-Newton, NICER, NuSTAR and HXMT data. For the five among eight MeV pulsars, the X-ray spectra can be fitted by a broken-power law model with a break energy of ∼ 5 − 10 \sim 5-10 keV.

arxiv-2405-00981.title: Bayesian Optimization with LLM-Based Acquisition Functions for Natural Language Preference Elicitation Conference: 18th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems; October 14–18, 2024; Bari, Italy 18th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys ’24), October 14–18, 2024, Bari, Italy DOI: 10.1145/36404
arxiv-2405-00981.creator: David Eric Austin, Anton Korikov, Armin Toroghi, Scott Sanner
arxiv-2405-00981.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by David Eric Austin, Anton Korikov, Armin Toroghi, Scott Sanner. Designing preference elicitation (PE) methodologies that can quickly ascertain a user’s top item preferences in a cold-start setting is a key challenge for building effective and personalized conversational recommendation (ConvRec) systems. While large language models (LLMs) enable fully natural language (NL) PE dialogues, we hypothesize that monolithic LLM NL-PE approaches lack the multi-turn, decision-theoretic reasoning required to effectively balance the exploration and exploitation of user preferences towards an arbitrary item set.

arxiv-2405-04206.title: NOVA: No C-based V ector Unit for Mapping A ttention Layers on a CNN Accelerator
arxiv-2405-04206.creator: Mohit Upadhyay, Rohan Juneja, Weng-Fai Wong and Li-Shiuan Peh
arxiv-2405-04206.description: Abstract Attention mechanisms are becoming increasingly popular, being used in neural network models in multiple domains such as natural language processing (NLP) and vision applications, especially at the edge. However, attention layers are difficult to map onto existing neuro accelerators since they have a much higher density of non-linear operations, which lead to inefficient utilization of today’s vector units.

arxiv-2508-06631.title: Einstein Telescope: Ferromagnetic Shielding for Magnetic Noise Mitigation
arxiv-2508-06631.creator: Federico Armato \from ins:x \from ins:y, Barbara Garaventa \from ins:x, Andrea Chincarini \from ins:x
arxiv-2508-06631.description: Abstract The Einstein Telescope is the next-generation gravitational wave interferometer which, compared to current detectors, will enable the observation of gravitational signals at lower frequencies with a sensitivity improved by approximately two orders of magnitude. Achieving such exceptional sensitivity requires minimizing all sources of noise. In the low-frequency regime, magnetic noise is one of the dominant.

arxiv-2509-16172.title: Two Strategies to Improve the Stålmarck Procedure
arxiv-2509-16172.creator: Sergei Leonov, Liam Davis
arxiv-2509-16172.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce StalmarckSAT, the a modern re-implementation of the Stålmarck Procedure for SAT solving, and present two novel strategies to improve the Procedure, Cardinality Driven Branching (CDB) and Deductive Priority Ordering (DPO). CDB is a heuristic to improve branching with the dilemma rule, and DPO intelligently orders simple rules based on their deductive potential.

arxiv-2511-16539.title: Probing moiré excitons in MoSe 2 /WSe 2 heterobilayers by combined micro-photoluminescence and lateral force microscopy
arxiv-2511-16539.creator: L. Caussou 1 , H. Moutaabbid 4 , M. Bernard 1 , F. Margaillan 1 , T. Taniguchi 3 , K. Watanabe 3 , C. Lagoin 1,2 , F. Dubin 1,2 and V. Voliotis 1
arxiv-2511-16539.description: Abstract We study interlayer excitons in MoSe 2 /WSe 2 heterobilayers, by combining lateral force microscopy and micro-photoluminescence spectroscopy. This allows us to correlate the spatial profile of the moiré superlattice with the distribution of optically active states accessible to interlayer excitons.

arxiv-2602-18857.title: VariBASed: Variational Bayes-Adaptive Sequential Monte-Carlo Planning for Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2602-18857.creator: Joery A. de Vries, Jinke He, Yaniv Oren, Pascal R. van der Vaart, Mathijs M. de Weerdt, Matthijs T. J. Spaan
arxiv-2602-18857.description: Abstract Optimally trading-off exploration and exploitation is the holy grail of reinforcement learning as it promises maximal data-efficiency for solving any task. Bayes-optimal agents achieve this, but obtaining the belief-state and performing planning are both typically intractable. Although deep learning methods can greatly help in scaling this computation, existing methods are still costly to train.

pmc-10635425.title: Improving vasculoprotective effects of MSCs in coronary microvessels – benefits of 3D culture, sub-populations and heparin
pmc-10635425.creator: Kobkaew Bumroongthai, Dean P. J. Kavanagh, Paul Genever, Neena Kalia
pmc-10635425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionOpening occluded coronary arteries in patients with myocardial infarction (MI) damages the delicate coronary microvessels through a process called myocardial ischaemia-reperfusion injury. Although mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) have the potential to limit this injury, clinical success remains limited. This may be due to (i) poor MSC homing to the heart (ii) infused MSCs, even if derived from the same site, being a heterogeneous population with varying therapeutic efficacy and (iii) conventional 2D culture of MSCs decreasing their homing and beneficial properties.

pmc-10659184.title: Advocating for PCR-RFLP as molecular tool within malaria programs in low endemic areas and low resource settings
pmc-10659184.creator: Mergiory Y. Labadie-Bracho, Malti R. Adhin
pmc-10659184.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The road to malaria elimination for low- and middle-income countries is paved with obstacles, including the complexity and high costs of advanced molecular methods for genomic analysis. The usefulness of PCR-RFLP as less complex and affordable molecular surveillance tool in low-endemic malaria regions was assessed in a cross-sectional study conducted in Suriname, currently striving for malaria elimination, but plagued by recent P.

pmc-11311836.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Extracellular Vesicles Derived from Human Immature Dental Pulp Cells on Papillary Thyroid Cancer
pmc-11311836.creator: Michelli Ramires Teixeira, Anderson Lucas Alievi, Vitor Rodrigues da Costa, Irina Kerkis, Rodrigo Pinheiro Araldi, Regina Golan-Gerstl
pmc-11311836.description: Mesenchymal stem-cell-derived extracellular vesicles (MSC-EVs) have been increasingly investigated for cancer therapy and drug delivery, and they offer an advanced cell-free therapeutic option. However, their overall effects and efficacy depend on various factors, including the MSC source and cargo content.

pmc-11443962.title: Direct and indirect effects of copepod grazers on community structure
pmc-11443962.creator: Kristie Rigby, Elisa Berdalet, Carina Berglund, Fabian Roger, Michael Steinke, Mahasweta Saha, Wiebke Grebner, Emily Brown, Uwe John, Lars Gamfeldt, Patrick Fink, Fredrick Berggren, Erik Selander
pmc-11443962.description: Ecological theory and empirical research show that both direct lethal effects and indirect non-lethal effects can structure the composition of communities. While the direct effects of grazers on marine phytoplankton communities are well studied, their indirect effects are still poorly understood. Direct and indirect effects are inherently difficult to disentangle in plankton food webs.

pmc-11458535.title: Comprehensive insights into UTIs: from pathophysiology to precision diagnosis and management
pmc-11458535.creator: Swathi Sujith, Adline Princy Solomon, John Bosco Balaguru Rayappan
pmc-11458535.description: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are the second most common infectious disease, predominantly impacting women with 150 million individuals affected globally. It increases the socio-economic burden of society and is mainly caused by Escherichia coli, Proteus mirabilis, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Enterobacter spp., and Staphylococcus spp. The severity of the infection correlates with the host factors varying from acute to chronic infections.

pmc-11509538.title: Automated Fabrication of Smart Strain Sensing Threads
pmc-11509538.creator: Ege Ozgul, Wenxin Zeng, Sameer Sonkusale, Wei Gao
pmc-11509538.description: With favorable properties of stretchability, stitchability, and potential to be woven into a fabric, thread-based sensors have gained considerable interest for wearable devices for smart and connected health applications. To facilitate wearable applications, an easy and reliable way to fabricate these thread-based sensors with good performance and consistency is the key while manufacturing these smart threads.

pmc-11599845.title: High carriage and possible hidden spread of multidrug-resistant Salmonella among asymptomatic workers in Yulin, China
pmc-11599845.creator: Xin Lu, Ming Luo, Mengyu Wang, Zhemin Zhou, Jialiang Xu, Zhenpeng Li, Yao Peng, Yuan Zhang, Fangyu Ding, Dong Jiang, Changyu Zhou, Liya Yang, Wenxuan Zhao, Tian Ma, Bo Pang, Meiying Yan, Yongning Wu, Yannong Wu, Biao Kan
pmc-11599845.description: Food workers have frequent contact with unprocessed foods, but their carriage of Salmonella and potential influence on public health have not been comprehensively assessed. We investigated Salmonella carriage among food workers compared with non-food workers based on occupational health screening of 260,315 asymptomatic workers over an 8-year surveillance period in Yulin, China.

pmc-11603744.title: Body mass index and penile cancer incidence: results from a Norwegian cohort study of 829,081 men
pmc-11603744.creator: Dagfinn Aune, Marie Nordsletten, Tor Åge Myklebust, Trude Eid Robsahm, Bjørn Steen Skålhegg, Tom Mala, Sheraz Yaqub, Usman Saeed
pmc-11603744.description: BackgroundA few previous studies have suggested a possible association between adiposity and increased risk of penile cancer, however, the evidence is to date limited for this rare cancer. We investigated the association between body mass index (BMI) and penile cancer risk in a large Norwegian cohort.MethodsThe analyses included 829,081 men aged 16–75 years at baseline in 1963–1975.

pmc-12496516.title: Split-thickness skin graft using scalp as a donor site for third-degree burn treatment in a newborn (case report)
pmc-12496516.creator: Paula Andrea Pérez Franco, Sebastian Murcia Espino, Mauricio Alfonso Uribe Rodríguez, Juan Felipe Vera Rodríguez, Jorge Elias Ochoa Martinez
pmc-12496516.description: Introduction and importanceNeonatal burns are uncommon but represent a critical medical challenge due to the physiological vulnerability of newborns, including fragile skin, immature immune response, and limited physiological reserves. Most burns in this population are iatrogenic, often preventable with proper care and equipment handling.

pmc-12622580.title: Revealing the genetic and immunological crosstalk between SLE and ccRCC: An integrative genomic analysis approach
pmc-12622580.creator: Feng Lin, Kewei Yang, Dan Li, Tianqi Chen, Tianbo Luo, Feifei Fu
pmc-12622580.description: Although systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) are clinically distinct, emerging evidence suggests they may share underlying genetic and immunoregulatory mechanisms. However, the specific molecular basis of their potential comorbidity has not been clearly defined, and no prior study has comprehensively investigated their shared genomic architecture.

pmc-12780433.title: Single-incision versus multi-incision minimally invasive esophagectomy with different reconstruction routes for esophageal cancer: a retrospective propensity-weighted analysis
pmc-12780433.creator: Ruirong Lin, Weikun Su, Guibin Weng, Yijin Lin, Lin Chen, Jiarong Zhang, Yibin Cai, Weimin Fang
pmc-12780433.description: BackgroundThe treatment of esophageal cancer requires optimized surgical approaches to improve patient outcomes. Minimally invasive esophagectomy (MIE) has demonstrated advantages compared to open procedures, but the difference in efficacy of single-incision versus multi-incision techniques under various reconstruction routes remains unclear.

pmc-13085975.title: Animal models accurately representing acute liver failure (Review)
pmc-13085975.creator: Sang Luo, Fang Wu, Yiran Jin, Xiaofen Huang, Dan Liu, Bingren Tian
pmc-13085975.description: Animal models are essential for investigating disease pathogenesis and progression. Acute liver injury (ALI) precedes acute liver failure (ALF), establishing a crucial and close relationship between these conditions. Appropriate animal models are required in order to develop successful treatments for ALF.

pmc-13091512.title: Post-heparin plasma lipase activities in patients with severe hypertriglyceridemia treated with evinacumab
pmc-13091512.creator: Cecilia Vitali, Poulabi Banerjee, Robert Pordy, Peter Ehmann, Robert S Rosenson, Daniel J Rader
pmc-13091512.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Patients with severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG) have variable lipoprotein lipase (LPL) activity levels that may influence therapeutic response. This exploratory analysis investigated post-heparin triglyceride lipase and phospholipase activities in three cohorts of patients with sHTG who received evinacumab (angiopoietin-like 3 inhibitor) for 12 or 24 weeks during a phase 2 trial: cohort 1, familial chylomicronemia syndrome with bi-allelic loss-of-function (LOF) LPL pathway mutations; cohort 2, multifactorial chylomicronemia syndrome (MCS) with heterozygous LOF LPL pathway mutations; and cohort 3, MCS without LPL pathway mutations.

pmc-13184889.title: Bilateral Coronary Artery–to–Pulmonary Artery Fistula Treated Using Minimally Invasive Coils and Vascular Embolization Devices

pmc-13184889.description: BackgroundCoronary artery–to–pulmonary artery fistula (CAPF) is a rare condition that is often asymptomatic; however, intervention is indicated in symptomatic patients or in those with myocardial ischemia.Case SummaryA 44-year-old woman with a cardiac murmur since early adulthood presented with progressive exertional dyspnea. Cardiac computed tomography revealed bilateral plexus-like CAPF with aneurysmal formation. Although the Qp/Qs ratio was 1.

pmc-13363471.title: Serum 25-Hydroxyvitamin D Status and 12-Week Functional Outcomes After Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy for Lateral Epicondylitis: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13363471.creator: Ki-Hyeok Ku, Eo Jin Park
pmc-13363471.description: Background/Objectives: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] is a clinically used biomarker of vitamin D nutritional status, although it is also influenced by sunlight exposure, supplementation, season, and other host factors. Short-term functional status after extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) for lateral epicondylitis varies. We evaluated whether serum 25(OH)D level and status were associated with 12-week functional outcomes among ESWT-treated patients.

pmc-13406783.title: Role of Endogenous Myoglobin in Anthracycline Response in Breast Cancer
pmc-13406783.creator: Ilona Rybinska, Andreas Petry, Thomas Hankeln, Thomas A. Gorr, Gaetano Cairo
pmc-13406783.description: Anthracyclines such as doxorubicin (DOX) remain central components of breast cancer (BC) chemotherapy, although their efficacy is frequently limited by drug resistance. Myoglobin (MB), an oxygen-binding heme protein expressed in breast tumors, has been implicated in the detoxification of DOX in cardiomyocytes, but its role in BC remains unclear.

pmc-13594646.title: Invasive meningococcal disease over five decades in the Faroe Islands: high incidence, low mortality, and implications for vaccination policy
pmc-13594646.creator: Gunnhild Helmsdal, Shahin Gaini
pmc-13594646.description: Highlights•Invasive meningococcal disease is a severe but preventable infection. While incidence has declined in many countries, less is known about long-term patterns in small, isolated populations. We examined 45 years of data from the Faroe Islands, where incidence has been relatively high and vaccination is not part of the routine program, to better understand disease trends and inform prevention strategies.
